title: cow.commit
description: Commit a previously-approved COW-gated intent. The client presents the intent_id it received in a `requires_cow_approval` ticket, plus the operation + subject for op-swap protection. mcpd validates against its IntentStore, consumes the intent, then dispatches to the real fs.delete / fs.write / package.* execution path. Failure modes surface as an err-status result (never -32603): expired, not-found, operation-mismatch, subject-mismatch. Added in M7.0.1c (v6.16).

intent_id.description: UUID from the preview ticket (fs.delete / fs.write / package.* response's intent_id field).

operation.description: Must match the operation of the intent registered under intent_id. Op-swap protection.

subject.description: Path (for fs.*) or package name (for package.*). Must match the subject of the intent registered under intent_id. Subject-swap protection.
